summary: Master conflict resolution in the hospitality industry with our specialized training course. Equip yourself with essential skills to handle challenges.
lede: Conflict resolution training for hospitality helps guest-facing staff and team leads handle guest complaints and workplace disagreements calmly. It develops active listening and empathy, practical de-escalation, and service-recovery skills, including setting realistic solutions and following up; it also covers internal team conflicts and professional responses to online complaints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for hospitality professionals who regularly deal with guests and internal teams in moments of pressure or disagreement.
audience: Guest relations and customer experience officers
Hotel, resort, and lodge managers or supervisors
Restaurant and F&B managers, hosts/hostesses, and wait
modules: Active Listening and Empathy for Guest Relations
Service Recovery: Turning Complaints into Loyalty
Handling Difficult Guests and High-Risk Situations
Conflict Resolution Across Cultures and Generations
Digital and Online Conflict: Reviews and Social Media
Building Personal and Organizational Conflict Resolution Habits
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 1 year of experience in a hospitality role. Prior exposure to guest-facing situations is beneficial but not mandatory. A willingness to engage in role-play and group activities is essential.
